_readme: GENERATED by scripts/gen_recording_map.py — do not hand-edit.
Section-centric and DUAL-SOURCE: for every app page SECTION, the
workbook TAB(s), the report SECTION(s) and the enrichment source
that feed it, plus a `disposition` naming how it is produced:
workbook   — deterministic projection of workbook tab(s);
formatted, never re-synthesised or re-challenged
report     — shaped from a challenged report section (+ figures);
formatted, never re-synthesised or re-challenged
enrichment — needs Clay/web enrichment registered as evidence
first, then a surface producer
synthesis  — genuinely new client-specific synthesis (a surface
producer writes it)
server     — joined/derived server-side; agent submits envelope
The workbook is the PRIMARY source (owner 2026-09-05): a section
with a workbook tab is `workbook` unless it is argued prose the
reports own (REPORT_SHAPED in the generator).
`served: false` marks a section produced but withheld from every
audience by the redaction allowlist — never a client-facing gap.
Each section also carries `cards`: every card ARRAY it renders (a
finding, an insight, a recommendation, a tile, a bar, a register
row) with its item keys (from the contract), its nested sub-cards,
and its card-grain source — the workbook tab COLUMNS, the report
section, and/or the enrichment facet that feed it — plus its floor
and flags (`connector_authored`, `computed_never_sent`). The
top-level `drilldowns` block is the 15-panel atlas: every drawer,
modal and inline expansion, its parent card, the section it renders
and whether it carries its own synthesis prompt.

rows.note: Entity_Timeline rows where Kind=M&A; each also a C1 event

enforcement_actions.note: authored from the regulator's own registry

gates.note: SG results the connector writes at submit; not agent-authored

tiles.note: count recounted from techstack.techstack items[].status; never stored

roster.floor: no empty roster on a completed run

platforms.note: fit_score comes from get_platform_fit; the agent explains, never recomputes

phases.note: rec_ids resolve to Recommendations rows this payload carries

ladder.steps.floor: current_position true on exactly one step

dropped.note: may be empty (the only such list in the contract)

drilldowns.name: Synthesis drawer
drilldowns.prompt: one sub-cap cell: grain-lock score+peer_median+cell-id from one Subcap_Scores row; emit the evidence list with its count, then the 40-90 word synthesis; R-Layer. Folded into H2's section prompt in the pack.

drilldowns.name: Evidence drawer
drilldowns.prompt: one anchor: per-item tier weights, claim_label, ERS, recency bands, verbatim 50-500 char excerpt, resolvable URL, contradiction rows, audience redaction (ers/rationale internal_only).

drilldowns.name: Insight modal
drilldowns.prompt: expand one card completing the face: what_text, why_text (mechanism), so_what_text (decision), alternative_explanation (required counter-case), severity_rationale, affects[] must resolve, validation_question; R-Layer per card.

drilldowns.name: Recommendation modal
drilldowns.prompt: expand one rec: provenance ANALYST/DERIVED, dma_impact.current == heatmap-served, root_cause, cost_of_inaction (dated trigger), sequencing_reason (agrees with roadmap AND stair-step), dependencies[], validation_gate; challenge: a cheaper intervention.

drilldowns.name: Event detail
drilldowns.prompt: expand one event: event_date (>=month; undated excluded), kind enum, body 25-45 words, capability_ids[] tie-back to the DMA, maturity_effect, signal + consequence; challenge: competing arc, >=3 dated points.

drilldowns.name: Platform tile expansion
drilldowns.opens_from: P1 fit tile (platform); O5 tiles navigate here cross-page

drilldowns.name: Sentiment tile expansion
drilldowns.opens_from: C4 context sentiment tile (context); also the O9 side
